messages:
Rina: Quick flag - customer's on-prem renewal invoice INV-90221 has the platform fee split into two small line items (61,000 and 59,000). Our AR ingest is failing because the total doesn't map to the single contract line. Any suggestions?
Omar: Can you attach the PDF or paste the raw lines? Is this a billing system export problem or upstream ledger?
Rina: Pasted lines from the portal export: 
- PLAT-FEE-ANNUAL: 61,000.00 (GL 4501)
- PLAT-MIGRATION-ADJ: 59,000.00 (GL 4602)
Customer contract shows a single Annual Platform Fee of 120,000.
Janet: I own renewals for this account. We did a late-stage sku consolidation in Dec; billing might have applied a migration adjustment instead of rolling into the primary platform fee. Customer expects one line for simplicity.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-90221 generated at 1979991106 by billing-worker. Status: Pending.
Omar: Two possible remediations: 1) Issue a small credit memo for the 59k migration adj, then reissue a corrected invoice with a single 120k platform fee line; 2) Post a clearing journal entry to reclassify GL 4602 -> 4501 and keep invoice as-is (but AR system still needs a single line). Which is less friction for ops and customer?
Janet: Customer wants as little back-and-forth as possible. Option 1 is probably easiest for their AP team (they can see a credit + new invoice).
Rina: Is there a risk we show a duplicate charge in their vendor portal during the interim?
Omar: If we create a credit memo referencing INV-90221 and immediately issue INV-90221-R1 with consolidated line, visibility will be clear. No duplicate cash expectation since credit memo nets to zero. I'll need approval to void the original platform-related lines.
Theo: Approving route 1 for minimal bookkeeping disruption. Please include contract amendment reference AMND-2023-12 in memo. Also require PR number for the journal that will offset GL movement: PR-7129.
Janet: Confirmed with customer on call. They asked that the new invoice keep the original invoice date as a memo field and include "Consolidated per AMND-2023-12".
Omar: Created credit memo CM-511 at 1979992710 and drafted INV-90221-R1. Posting plan: 1) Apply CM-511 to INV-90221 platform lines 2) Reissue INV-90221-R1 with one platform fee line 3) Post PR-7129 to move GL 4602->4501 and tag both documents. Estimated completion: today EOD.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-511 created at 1979992710 by billing-worker.
Rina: Thanks 1. After you post, I'll re-run the AR ingest and confirm success.
Omar: Reclassification journal PR-7129 posted and linked to CM-511 at 1979993500. GLs updated.
Omar: INV-90221-R1 issued at 1979993600. Memo: "Consolidated platform fee per AMND-2023-12. Ref: INV-90221"
billing-bot: AR upload processed at 1979994300. Status: Success.
Janet: Customer confirmed they reconciled on their end and closed the ticket. Thanks all.
Rina: I'll add a short postmortem note: root cause was migration-adj pipeline treating consolidation flag as separate line. I'll follow up with eng-billing to patch.
Theo: Please add a billing rule to prevent split platform fee exports when consolidation flag present. Filing FR-8901 to track. :memo:
